info.name: Uniform Platform Aggregates Project Map API

params.name: projectMapId
params.description: The project map id that the desired nodes belong

params.name: projectId
params.description: The project id that contains the project map tree that this node belongs to

params.name: releaseId
params.description:
The ID of a release to fetch the composition data for.

- When unspecified, composition data is fetched from base.
- When specified, all content is returned as it would appear in the release if it was released now. This includes both content copied to the release and changed, as well as content that is not part of the release.

Content copied to a release can be differentiated from base content by the `releaseId` property on the content. If the content is not copied to the release, this property will not be defined

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the node to retrieve, cannot have both this parameter and `path`

params.name: path
params.description: The path of the root node to retrieve, cannot have both this parameter and `id`

params.name: compositionId
params.description: Composition id to find associated project map node for

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number or records returned by a number

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip before returning nodes

params.name: depth
params.description: Depth of the tree to fetch. This only applies when fetching by path

params.name: state
params.description: State of compositions to fetch. 0 = draft, 64 = published

params.name: tree
params.description: should the data be returned as a json tree object (or a flat array)

params.name: includeAncestors
params.description:
Modifies the results to include all ancestors of matched nodes, in addition to the nodes themselves.
Results are sorted by path. If multiple nodes are selected, ancestors are not duplicated

params.name: expanded
params.description: include expanded helper computed properties, including `isLeaf`, `parentPath`, `pathSegment` etc

params.name: withCompositionData
params.description: include basic composition information.  ID, type, state, name, and definition id

params.name: withCompositionUIStatus
params.description:
Returns the UI status string of the composition.
This internal status is subject to change without notice and is thus marked deprecated to discourage the use of internal data
